name: ABANDONED WORKSHOP AREA
text: This upper section houses dilapidated
workstations and forgotten tech. The warm glow
of a desk lamp casts long shadows across
scattered paperwork and a microscope.

name: PLANT RESEARCH FLOOR
text: The lower level houses the remaining
experimental plant tanks. A faint,
bioluminescent glow pulses from the murky
water channel cutting across the floor.

name: GLOWING WATER CHANNEL
text: The water here glows a sickly, unnatural teal.
Whatever chemicals leak from the machinery
upstream have permanently altered the liquid.

name: CENTRAL SPECIMEN TANKS
text: These two glass cylinders hold broad-leafed
plants suspended in a nutrient bath. They are
hooked up to a complex, rusty pipe system.

name: RIGHT SPECIMEN TANKS
text: One tank holds a stunted, struggling fern,
while the other contains a dead, skeletal
branch. The glass is fogged with condensation
and grime.

name: TANGLED SUPPORT PIPING
text: A messy network of pipes feeds into the
specimen tanks, pumping necessary fluids and
gases. They are caked in rust and patches of
dried, teal sludge.

name: LOWER MAINTENANCE VENT
text: A heavy-duty ventilation unit is built into
the lower wall, likely to manage the fumes
from the glowing canal. It hums with a low,
vibrating rattle.

name: UPPER WATER CHANNEL
text: The glowing liquid pours from a dark, circular
pipe opening in the wall, flowing steadily
under a metal walkway.

name: LOWER BULKHEAD DOOR
text: This thick metal door is framed by a glowing
teal strip, indicating it still has power. It
likely leads deeper into the facility's lower
levels.

name: DISCARDED CRATES
text: A stack of old metal crates and a torn bag sit
forgotten in the corner. They're covered in a
thick layer of dust, untouched for years.

name: WESTERN PLATFORM EDGE
text: This concrete edge overlooks the glowing
canal, littered with small, rusted metal
components and a discarded barrel.

name: TALL SPECIMEN TANK
text: This larger cylinder holds a surprisingly
healthy, multi-tiered leafy plant. The teal
liquid inside seems slightly clearer than the
rest.

name: LOWER VENTILATION UNIT
text: A rusted, boxy air conditioner unit sits near
the bottom walkway. It's connected to the wall
by a thick, insulated pipe.

name: FAR RIGHT TANK
text: A lone tank stands against the far wall,
holding another broad-leafed specimen. A loose
cable rests on the floor nearby, disconnected
from its terminal.
